entries.german: Cuntz von Hardheim, the boy, and Anna von Rosenberg, his wife, sell interest to the Bronnbach monastery and Gülten at Bütthard (Buetert) around 42 guilders. / "The give is do man sing according to Cristus' birth druczehen hundred jor and dor still in the siben and eightyth jor at the nechsten mentag still the jorstag"
entries.english: Cuntz von Hardheim, the boy, and Anna von Rosenberg, his wife, sell interest to the Bronnbach monastery and Gülten at Bütthard (Buetert) around 42 guilders. / "The give is do man sing according to Cristus' birth druczehen hundred jor and dor still in the seven and eightyth jor at the next mentag still the jorstag"
